package.name: fossbot_description
package.description:
URDF and meshes for the FOSSBot edu v2, for use with the real-robot bridge.
Derived from fossbot_educational_description in LRMPUT/FOSSBotEduSim, with the gazebo plugin block removed; re-sync with sync_description.sh if the sim model changes. The upstream package declares no license, so this one does not assert one either -- set both together when upstream is decided.
